categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Wanxiang Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: consumer electronics precision components and new energy power/storage battery precision components. The company focuses on R&D, production, and sales of products along the lithium battery industry chain, including thermal protection components, digital transmission control integrated components, precision structural parts, flexible functional components, micro lithium-ion batteries, and battery module components for new energy vehicles and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered core manufacturing technologies such as mold development, stamping, welding, die-cutting, electroplating, hot pressing, and injection molding. It emphasizes automation and has developed automated production lines and information systems to improve efficiency and quality. Proprietary technologies include 'glass-metal sealing' and 'glass-sealed explosion-proof valve' for micro lithium-ion batteries, as well as advanced automated equipment for welding, testing, and assembly.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international consumer electronics and power/storage battery manufacturers such as Apple, Huawei, Microsoft, HP, Dell, Samsung, Lenovo, Meta, CATL, BYD, Desay, and Sunwoda. End markets cover laptops, tablets, smartphones, TWS earphones, smart wearables, new energy vehicles, and energy storage systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Suzhou, Changzhou, Chongqing, and Dongguan, and has expanded globally with a production base in Vietnam. Sales cover domestic regions including East China, South China, Southwest China, and overseas markets, notably Europe and emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wanxiang Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing precision components and modules for lithium batteries used in consumer electronics and new energy vehicles. It integrates upstream raw material procurement and downstream direct sales to brand customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development, increasing R&D investment to enhance product technology and automation. Key R&D directions include battery connector terminals, dust-proof speaker components, automated welding machines, flexible circuit boards, and advanced battery module structures. It aims to expand product applications in AI-enabled devices and new energy sectors while strengthening global manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of precision components and battery modules to brand customers under framework agreements and purchase orders. The company follows a direct sales model with customized product development based on client specifications, generating income from product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Wanxiang Technology is positioned as a leading manufacturer in the precision components segment for consumer electronics and new energy batteries in China. It competes with other domestic and international suppliers in the lithium battery and consumer electronics supply chains, leveraging its technological innovation, automation, and strong customer base to maintain and grow market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.09 billion, a 24.51% increase year-over-year. However, net profit attributable to shareholders was a loss of RMB 16.39 million, declining 165.33% due to market competition, R&D and capacity ramp-up costs, and industry pricing pressures. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.86 billion, with steady growth in revenue driven by new energy and consumer electronics segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wanxiang Technology emphasizes high-quality, precision manufacturing with advanced automation and proprietary technologies to deliver reliable, innovative components. Its value proposition includes strong R&D capabilities, rapid customer response, comprehensive manufacturing processes, and a diversified product portfolio that supports AI integration and new energy applications, enabling customers to enhance product safety, performance, and competitiveness.
